services.desc: Three Ridges Events Off-Road Park - 4x4 Trails & Primitive Camping - Hinsdale, NH Three Ridges Off-Road Park offers self-guided trail access every Saturday and Sunday in Hinsdale, New Hampshire. Purchase your day pass online and arrive at your own pace - no guided groups, no fixed schedule. Trails are rated by difficulty, welcoming everything from stock Jeeps and trucks to modified 4x4 builds. Located in southern New Hampshire near Brattleboro, VT and Keene, NH, Three Ridges is one of the only private off-road parks in the region. blurb: Joining the Three Ridges Events membership program means more than saving money - it means becoming part of a community. Members unlock exclusive discounts on trail and camping purchases, access to members-only weekends featuring live music and locally sourced food, and a front-row seat to everything we have in store. As we continue to grow our membership offerings, one thing stays the same: members always get more.
